scene: The antique camera's crystal lens reflects a moving constellation of tiny gears.
picture: A tight close-up filling the frame with an ornate brass camera resting on velvet. On the left sits a knurled brass dial marked with astrological runes. Centre holds an illuminated crystal glass lens showing spinning clockwork cogs within, beneath a glowing prism viewfinder. Far right shows a curved silver shutter lever ready to press.

the glowing glass viewfinder prism situated directly at centre top
